entries.name: Egida
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Godmist classic pixel RPG passive icon source, later FULL-CANVAS nearest-neighbor reduced to32x32. Input image is STYLE ONLY: match chunky stepped pixel clusters, broad shaded metal facets, thick near-black charcoal outlines, large simple readable silhouette. One or two dominant foreground shapes fill square. Quiet grouped color planes, crisp facet highlights, no miniature details. Opaque square, no border/frame, text, letters, digits, UI, watermark, photorealism, smooth gradients, noise, microtexture, tiny particles. No repeated ornamental scratch/radial motif. Subject-specific effects stay BEHIND foreground. Commander tree uniform background: dark STEEL NAVY #182534 with subdued #26394c planes. Do not copy the red background or sword composition of reference. Silver physical, gold command, muted blue sight. Passive: Egida. Subject/composition: A large upright steel SWORD held before a broad muted GOLD protective arch. The sword is dominant and brightly empowered: this passive empowers an ally's DAMAGE after a readiness order, not just a defensive shield. One simple gold arch and one blade, no person or shield. One opaque square image.
